ambient_events: The cars behind the glass catch the light as a cloud moves off.
A hover car settles onto the roof pad and its fans wind down.
Somebody stops on the corner to look up at the car on the pylon.
description: A glass showroom on the corner of Marrow Street and Meltwater Row, under a thin white roof with a black sign band. Four hover cars stand on turntables behind the glass. A fifth is clamped nose-up on a pylon over the corner, and there is a landing pad on the roof. The doors are north.
name: Higher Purchase
